description: How close is bll6422 to any experimentally characterised FAH-superfamily enzyme?
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
PR="/agent/jobs/be6dde12-f424-4543-aa88-9103cb899c33/provenance/"
sw=pd.read_csv(PR+"sw_PF01557_vs_Q89GC3.csv")
meta=pd.read_csv(PR+"swissprot_PF01557.tsv",sep="\t")
meta=meta.rename(columns={"Entry":"acc"})
d=sw.merge(meta[["acc","Protein names","EC number","Organism","Catalytic activity","Protein existence"]],on="acc",how="left")
d["exp_EC"]=d["Catalytic activity"].astype(str).str.contains("ECO:0000269")
d["short"]=d["Protein names"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\s*\(.*","",regex=True).str[:52]
d["org"]=d["Organism"].astype(str).str.replace(r"\s*\(.*","",regex=True).str[:30]
d=d.sort_values("sw_score",ascending=False)
print("reviewed PF01557 entries aligned:",len(d))
print("with an experimentally evidenced CATALYTIC ACTIVITY (ECO:0000269):",int(d["exp_EC"].sum()))
print("\nTop 12 by Smith-Waterman score against bll6422 (344 aa):")
print(d.head(12)[["acc","short","org","EC number","len","sw_score","ident","aln_len","pct_id","exp_EC"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nHighest percent identity entries (short alignments inflate this):")
print(d.sort_values("pct_id",ascending=False).head(5)[["acc","short","aln_len","pct_id","sw_score"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nEC numbers represented among reviewed PF01557 entries with experimental evidence:")
ecs=sorted(set(sum([str(e).split("; ") for e in d.loc[d.exp_EC,"EC number"].dropna()],[]))-{"nan",""})
print(" ",ecs)
d.drop(columns=["Catalytic activity"]).to_csv(PR+"table_reviewed_FAH_vs_bll6422.csv",index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,5.2))
for flag,c,lab in [(True,"#c1442e","experimentally evidenced reaction (ECO:0000269)"),
                   (False,"#9aa5b1","reaction inferred, no experimental evidence")]:
    s=d[d.exp_EC==flag]
    ax.scatter(s["aln_len"],s["pct_id"],s=26,c=c,label=lab,edgecolor="none",alpha=.85)
top=d.head(1).iloc[0]
ax.annotate("%s  %s\n%s, %.1f%% over %d columns"%(top["acc"],top["short"],top["org"],top["pct_id"],top["aln_len"]),
            xy=(top["aln_len"],top["pct_id"]),xytext=(190,36),fontsize=8,
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#555"))
ax.axhline(30,ls="--",color="#888",lw=.8)
ax.text(300,30.6,"30% identity, the usual floor for transferring an enzyme reaction",fontsize=7.5,color="#666")
ax.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman alignment length against bll6422 (columns)")
ax.set_ylabel("percent identity to bll6422")
ax.set_title("All 99 reviewed Swiss-Prot proteins carrying the FAH domain PF01557, aligned to bll6422\nNo characterised member reaches 30% identity over a full-length alignment",fontsize=10.5)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="upper right",frameon=False); ax.spines[["top","right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
